newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan regional economies recovering slowly -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan regional economies recovering slowly -- MOF.

text.p: Regional economies in Japan are continuing to recover gradually, with private demand firming up, the Finance Ministry said on Wednesday.
In a summary of reports on regional economies, the ministry said Japan's employment situation remains severe, but there are some signs of improvement.
Public works spending is running at high levels, helping to put overall production activities in Japan on a gradual upward trend, it said.
Housing construction is picking up steadily, while capital spending and coporate earnings are improving, it added.
